2017 HYUNDAI Veloster
like a street bike with four
wheels and three doors.
We know what gives you a rush. Stop-light launches that thrust you back into your
seat. Handling that feels like you’re a carving knife that’s just been sharpened. Style
that’s anything but dull. So we made certain the Hyundai Veloster stands out from all
other compact performance coupes.
Our inspiration? Your aspiration to drive something with the soul of a high-
performance street bike. You can see it in Veloster’s aggressive shapes and bold
colors, inside and out. And feel it in the way a class-leading power-to-weight ratio
and Dual Clutch Transmission translate into acceleration, shifting and handling
that’s instantly responsive.
Whether you choose Veloster, Veloster Turbo, Turbo R-Spec or the new Value Edition,
get ready to enjoy the most interior volume of any car in its class.1 It’s space that’s
uniquely easy to access, thanks to an exclusive three-door design. So go ahead,
invite rear passengers along for the ride.
And there’s plenty of substance beneath all that Veloster style. Like your choice
of two torque-rich, eco-efficient engines. Powerful audio and touchscreen
navigation systems that sync with your smartphone and respond to voice
commands.2 Choose the new Veloster Value Edition, and a boatload of premium
features are included as standard equipment. Who knew a constant rush of
adrenaline could actually be so sensible?
1 Claim based on comparison of specifications on manufacturer websites.
2 Navigation system is standard on the Veloster Value Edition and available on Veloster Turbo.

stYlIsH AttItUDe
this is no place to hide.
Veloster isn’t looking to blend in. Hyundai designers pushed their
Fluidic Sculpture principles to the extreme, making sure that
Veloster has the sleek, muscular look to match its hot-hatch
performance. Its precisely cut wheel arches are stuffed with 17˝
alloys – 18˝ on Turbo and Value Edition. Projector headlights
with LED accents give the Turbo’s front a penetrating gaze. And
in back, chrome-tipped dual exhaust tips leave no doubt about
Veloster’s street cred.
Step inside, and Veloster stays true to form. A leather-wrapped
steering wheel and shifter are standard on all models. And on the
2017 Turbo, an available black leather seating scheme includes
vivid orange accent seat trim, alloy sport pedals and high-gloss
black accents on the console, dash and doors.
The versatility beneath Veloster’s form is equally eye-popping:
Leave the rear seats up, and you’ve got 15.5 cubic feet of cargo
space – more than some leading compact sedans. Fold the rear
seats flat, and its best-in-class 34.7 cubic feet of space becomes
readily accessible via the wide (and low) rear hatch opening.1
1 Claim based on comparison of specifications on manufacturer websites. 2 Available on Veloster Turbo, standard on Value Edition. 3 Android Auto works with smartphones running on Android 5.0,™ Lollipop or higher. Android, Android Auto, Google Play and other marks are
trademarks of Google Inc. Apple CarPlay works with iPhone 5 and later models running the latest version of iOS 7.1 and above. Apple is a registered trademark of Apple Inc. Blue Link is standard on Value Edition, available on Veloster Turbo. Blue Link subscription service
agreement required. Features vary by subscription plan. Blue Link service works using CDMA-based cellular networks in the 50 United States. Blue Link service is not available where there is no cellular coverage, particularly in enclosed or remote areas. Service availability may
be affected by signal strength, foliage, weather, topographical conditions (mountains) and nearby structures (tall buildings, tunnels) and other factors. For additional details and system limitations, visit HyundaiBlueLink.com.

ROOm wiTh a ViEw
34.7 With Veloster’s panoramic sunroof, sitting inside of your car is a
mood-altering experience. Where other sport coupes can make you
CU FT feel closed-in, Veloster’s interior becomes an airy space filled with
light. The expansive glass of the panoramic roof spans both the front
with rear and rear rows, offering everyone a seat with a view.2
seats down
EYES On ThE PRiZE
Veloster's driver-oriented interior was inspired by motorcycle
designs. The shape and layout of the controls, vents, switches and
dials in its unique center stack is not just cool looking – it’s actually
easy to see everything in the cockpit at a glance.
3-door
hOLd iT RiGhT ThERE
design
Veloster’s wide and low hatch design makes loading and unloading
cargo easy. And its 60/40 split-folding rear seats let you maximize
the 34.7 cubic feet of space. So whether your plan is to pick up a few
friends or pack up a week’s worth of stuff, you’ve got the flexibility to
make it happen.
VELOSTER VaLuE EdiTiOn
The new Veloster Value Edition covers what’s on your wish list
for less. Tunes? Dimension® Premium Audio is standard – with
an external amp and 8 speakers (including an 8˝ subwoofer),
it kicks out the jams. Wheels? The Value Edition sports 5-spoke
18˝alloys with painted inserts. Advanced tech? The 7˝ touchscreen
navigation system features junction view lane guidance and a split-
screen display. It also integrates seamlessly with Apple CarPlay™
and Android Auto,™ and Hyundai Blue Link® places a wide range of
connected car features at your fingertips.3 Sun-filled room with a
view? That comes standard on Value Edition, too, compliments of
VELOSTER VaLuE EdiTiOn in Boston Red a panoramic sunroof.

1 Claim based on comparison of specifications on manufacturer websites. 2 Six-speed Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) available on
Veloster base model and standard on Value Edition. Seven-speed DCT available on Veloster Turbo. 3 Electronic Stability Control
(ESC) cannot control your vehicle’s stability under all driving situations. ESC is not a substitute for safe driving practices. No
system, no matter how advanced, can overcome physics or correct poor driving. The driver is always responsible for controlling
the vehicle and must use caution to avoid loss of control in all driving conditions. Speed, road conditions and driver steering
input will affect whether ESC can help prevent loss of control. See Owner’s Manual for details. VELOSTER VaLuE EdiTiOn in Pacific Blue

Link subscription required. Remote Vehicle Start is only available for push button start equipped vehicles with an automatic transmission or a Dual Clutch Transmission. Remote Climate VELOSTER TuRBO with Tech Package
Control is available on properly equipped models with fully automatic temperature control. See Owner’s Manual for detailed specifications and limitations. in Black Leather with Orange accents
